'''Ithorian Mariner's wristwraps''' were an item of medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]] worn during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] by mariner's. They were grey in color. Whether they were made by the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] or simply named for them is unknown.
